The City of Houston publishes its 311 data through its GIS server rather than a single open-data download, and I found two main datasets.

- **Archived/full dataset:** The "Houston311_Service_Requests" layer on the city's ArcGIS server holds all publicly available service requests filed in the LAGAN. It is refreshed monthly, and its BARC (animal-related) tickets are excluded because they sit in a separate Chameleon system, so you would join it with the PUBLIC_BARC_Location layer for a complete picture (a companion dataset).
- **Recent requests:** A separate "Houston311 Recent Service Requests" layer covers open cases and closed cases within the last 2 weeks, and is updated every 30 minutes.
- **Query access:** Both layers support JSON, GeoJSON, and PBF queries, with a maximum of 2,000 records per request. Coordinates use NAD 1983 StatePlane Texas South Central (FIPS 4204, feet).
- **Other copies:** ArcGIS-hosted flood-event subsets, such as the Memorial Day and Tax Day flood 311 services, also exist (Houston 311 is the City of Houston's non-emergency service description applies to them).

The results do not confirm the current status of the broader city open data portal. An older article reported over 200 datasets available through the online portal, but that is dated, so check the portal directly for the current catalog. The city also runs a public dashboard that tracks and grades 311 service requests, per a December 2025 report.

content.text:
I could confirm four of the six cities directly. LA's current dataset and Houston's closure field are not confirmed.

| City | Dataset URL | Platform | Update frequency (as stated) | Earliest records | Closure field |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **NYC** | https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Social-Services/311-Service-Requests-from-2020-to-Present/erm2-nwe9 (ID `erm2-nwe9`) | Socrata | "This dataset is updated daily." | 2020 in this dataset. The 2010–2019 records were split out in Dec 2025 into https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Social-Services/311-Service-Requests-from-2010-to-2019/76ig-c548, so the earliest year overall is 2010. | `closed_date` |
| **Los Angeles** | https://data.lacity.org/A-Well-Run-City/MyLA311-Service-Request-Data-2016/ndkd-k878. This is the only MyLA311 dataset I could find, and it covers 2016 only. | Socrata | Weekly, per the dataset's metadata. | 2016 for MyLA311, per the metadata. The archived call-center dataset (`bpyg-ytsg`) covers 2013–2014. | `closeddate` |
| **Chicago** | https://data.cityofchicago.org/d/v6vf-nfxy | Socrata | "Updated multiple times per day." | 2018. The new 311 system launched 12/18/2018, and the earliest `created_date` is 2018-07-01. A few legacy-system records are flagged in `LEGACY_RECORD`. | `closed_date` |
| **Houston** | The "Houston311_Service_Requests" layer at https://mycity2.houstontx.gov/pubgis01/rest/services/311/311_ARCHIVED_CASES/MapServer/0. A separate "Recent Service Requests" layer, `Houston311_RecentServiceRequests`, holds open cases plus cases closed in the last 2 weeks. | ArcGIS REST (the city's own GIS server). I found no Socrata or CKAN listing. | Archive refreshed monthly; recent layer every 30 minutes. Both come from search-result summaries, not the service pages. | Not confirmed. | Not confirmed |
| **Philadelphia** | https://opendataphilly.org/datasets/311-service-and-information-requests/ | OpenDataPhilly front end with the data on CARTO (table `public_cases_fc`, queried at phl.carto.com) | Daily | 2014. The data starts 12/8/2014. | `closed_datetime` |
| **San Francisco** | https://data.sfgov.org/d/vw6y-z8j6 ("311 Cases"). That address redirects to data.sf.gov. | Socrata | "Updates nightly" around 6am Pacific. The metadata also lists publishing frequency as daily. | 2008. Cases are created since 7/1/2008. | `closed_date` |

Caveats:
- **NYC** `closed_date` is described as "Date SR was closed by responding agency."
- **Los Angeles:**
  - The 2016 dataset appears to be a year-specific slice. A successor for 2017 onward may exist under another name, but I couldn't locate it. The Socrata catalog search returned only the 2013–2014 archive and an app-download stats dataset.
  - The metadata says `closeddate` isn't used by every request type.
- **Houston:**
  - Both ArcGIS service pages returned HTTP 500 ("Service not started") when I tried them. Because of that, I couldn't read the field list or earliest year, and I won't guess them.
  - Check the layer again later, or read the field list at the layer URL with `?f=pjson`.
  - Houston doesn't appear to have a standard Socrata or CKAN 311 dataset.
- **San Francisco:** the minimum `closed_date` value is 1899-12-31, which looks like a placeholder or data error. The real earliest request is 2008-07-01.
- **Philadelphia:** the dataset page doesn't list a data dictionary. I got `closed_datetime` from a live query of the CARTO table, which returned a `timestamptz` field.

Sources:
- [NYC 311 dataset metadata](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/views/erm2-nwe9.json)
- [NYC 311 update notice](https://www.nyc.gov/opendata/news/all-news/311-Service-Requests-Updates)
- [Chicago 311 metadata](https://data.cityofchicago.org/api/views/v6vf-nfxy.json)
- [SF 311 Cases metadata](https://data.sf.gov/api/views/vw6y-z8j6.json)
- [LA MyLA311 2016 metadata](https://data.lacity.org/api/views/ndkd-k878.json)
- [LA Socrata catalog search](https://api.us.socrata.com/api/catalog/v1?domains=data.lacity.org&q=311%20service%20request&only=datasets&limit=20)
- [Houston 311 archived cases layer](https://mycity2.houstontx.gov/pubgis01/rest/services/311/311_ARCHIVED_CASES/MapServer/0)
- [OpenDataPhilly 311 page](https://opendataphilly.org/datasets/311-service-and-information-requests/)
- [Philadelphia CARTO query](https://phl.carto.com/api/v2/sql?q=select%20*%20from%20public_cases_fc%20limit%201)
